git.delete_branch.title: Delete branch?
git.delete_branch.force_description: Branch '{name}' is not fully merged. Force-deleting will lose unmerged commits. Continue?
git.discard.title: Discard changes?
git.discard.description: Uncommitted changes for '{path}' will be permanently removed. Continue?
git.dirty_checkout.title: Uncommitted changes
git.dirty_checkout.message: Workspace has uncommitted changes. Choose how to proceed:
git.dirty_checkout.question: Workspace has uncommitted changes. How do you want to switch to {branch}?
git.dirty_checkout.stash_hint: Stash: save changes to stash, checkout cleanly, then pop back.
git.dirty_checkout.force_hint: Force: skip the check — changes will be overwritten by git on conflict.
git.checkout_commit.title: Checkout commit (detached HEAD)?
git.checkout_commit.description: HEAD will point directly at commit {sha} instead of a branch. Any new commits won't belong to a branch until you create one or checkout back.
git.cherry_pick.title: Cherry-pick commit?
git.cherry_pick.description: Apply commit {sha} on top of {branch}. Conflicts will open the Conflict Resolver.
git.revert.title: Revert commit?
git.revert.description: Create an inverse commit of {sha} on {branch}. Conflicts will open the Conflict Resolver.
git.reset.title: Reset {branch} to {sha}
git.reset.description: Choose how the working tree and index are handled.
git.reset.mode.soft: Soft — keep working tree + index; only move HEAD.
git.reset.mode.mixed: Mixed (default) — keep working tree; reset index.
git.reset.mode.hard: Hard — DESTROY all uncommitted changes; match HEAD = target.
git.reset.hard_ack: I understand this will destroy uncommitted changes.
git.reset.modal.title: Reset '{branch}' to here?
git.reset.modal.body: HEAD of {branch} will move to commit {sha}. The reset mode controls whether the working tree and index are preserved.
git.reset.mode.soft.label: Soft
git.reset.mode.soft.detail: Move HEAD only. Index + working tree preserved — staged changes stay.
git.reset.mode.mixed.label: Mixed (default)
git.reset.mode.mixed.detail: Move HEAD + reset index. Working tree preserved — changes become unstaged.
git.reset.mode.hard.label: Hard
git.reset.mode.hard.detail: DESTROY uncommitted changes. Working tree + index = target commit.
git.tag.title: New tag
git.tag.name: Tag name
git.save_patch.title: Save commit as patch?
git.save_patch.description: A save dialog will open to choose where to write {sha}.patch.
git.abort_merge.title: Abort merge?
git.abort_merge.description: Working tree will be restored to the pre-merge state. All uncommitted changes from this merge will be lost. Continue?
git.detached.warn: — committing here will be lost unless you create a branch first.
git.detached.label: DETACHED HEAD
git.not_installed.description_old: AWOG requires Git ≥ {required}. Current version: {version}. Please upgrade Git then restart AWOG.
git.not_installed.description_missing: AWOG needs Git CLI ≥ {required} to version the workspace. Install Git then restart AWOG.
git.auth.title: Authentication failed
git.auth.lead: Git {op} failed to authenticate with the remote.
git.auth.hint.ssh_key: Check that your SSH key is added to the agent. Run `ssh-add` in your terminal.
git.auth.hint.https_token: HTTPS token expired or invalid. Update it via git credential helper / Keychain.
git.auth.hint.unknown: Authentication failed — check the credentials configured for this remote.
git.pull_divergence.title: Branch has diverged
git.pull_divergence.lead: Local branch and upstream have moved in two different directions.
git.pull_divergence.sub: Fast-forward is not possible. Choose how to reconcile:
git.pull_divergence.merge_hint: create a merge commit, keep both branches' history.
git.pull_divergence.rebase_hint: replay local commits on top of upstream, keep a linear history.
git.push_nonff.title: Push rejected
git.push_nonff.lead: Remote has new commits that local hasn't pulled. Git refused the non-fast-forward push.
git.push_nonff.sub: Pull (merge) first, then push again? If the pull fails / has conflicts, the sequence will stop and you'll need to resolve it manually.
git.commit_panel.detached_body: You are on detached HEAD {sha}. Committing here will be lost unless you create a branch first. Create branch {branch} to keep the commit, or commit anyway.
git.no_repo.title: Workspace has no Git repo
git.commit_detail.revert_file_title: Revert {path} to version before this commit
git.commit_detail.task_not_found: No task in store references this phase id
git.conflict.binary_note: Binary file — only a side can be picked, no inline editing.
git.compare.title: Compare
git.stash.drop_description: Stash will be permanently removed. Continue?
git.sidebar.title: Repository
git.branches.title: Branches
git.branches.click_hint: Click a branch to checkout. Right-click for more actions.
git.remotes.hint: Adding/removing remotes is not available in v1.
git.stashes.hint: Stash applies files into the working tree on pop / apply.
git.toast.merge_conflict_open_resolver: There were conflicts — opening Conflict Resolver
git.toast.stash_pop_conflict: Pop has conflict — stash@{index} kept, opening Conflict Resolver
git.toast.stash_apply_conflict: Apply has conflict — opening Conflict Resolver
git.toast.cherry_pick_conflict: Cherry-pick has conflict — opening Conflict Resolver
git.toast.revert_conflict: Revert has conflict — opening Conflict Resolver
git.toast.encoding_unsupported: Encoding not supported — open in external editor
git.toast.generate_need_stage: Stage at least 1 file before generating
git.toast.generate_no_sidecar: Sidecar not ready — cannot call AI
